title: APF Paper 13 — The Minimal Admissibility Core
description:
Master reference document. Comprehensive self-contained exposition of the entire APF framework. All 19 bank-registered modules + apf/standalone/, 342 bank-registered theorems, 355 verify_all checks (codebase v6.9), unified derivation from Axiom A1.

This repository is the executable mathematical appendix for Paper 13 of the Admissibility Physics Framework (APF). All theorems trace to named check functions in the bundled apf/ package.
